
### transmitting a signal  {.smaller}



* can vary...

   * voltage
   * radio/light intensity
   * radio/light frequency
   * ...

![](/physical/texfig/transmit-signal-transmitting-a-signal.figure.svg)


### some simplifying assumptions  {.smaller}

* signal low/high --- no in between
* only one ‘channel’  
   * won't have multiple wires/antennas/frequencies/etc.
   * won't modulate different things same time
* want to send receive bits (0 or 1)

![](/physical/texfig/transmit-signal-some-simplifying-assumptions.figure.svg){width=1050px}
